correctness.rationale: The complete face sets have exactly 312 and 710 nonempty simplices, verified by independent exhaustive tests. Fully checked globally acyclic matchings have critical vectors (1,0,8,1) and (1,0,1,32). The exact integer Morse 3-to-2 boundaries, calculated independently by recursive matched-face projection and direct unimodular pivot cancellation, both have Smith content exactly 2 and rank 1. The one-vertex/no-one-cell Morse two-skeleton is a wedge of two-spheres; Hurewicz plus integer changes of bases yields M(Z/2,2) wedge seven S2 and M(Z/2,2) wedge 31 S3 respectively. Direct original simplicial ranks over F2, F3 and F5 independently agree with the resulting UCT Betti vectors. Infinite generalization is not claimed.

value.rationale: These are natural consecutive widths in a two-part symmetric complete-bipartite family motivated by recent work on directed-cycle-bearing multipath complexes. Identifying the exact integral Moore summand (including an attaching map of degree two) is structurally different from an Euler-characteristic or field-homology computation and gives meaningful concrete torsion test cases beyond the previously classified bidirected polygon and tree families. Each exact finite classification stands without a promised future theorem.
